CustomField.description: Used in Approval flow to warn Approver to open Quote Line drawer to view and approve Qty Breaks.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Quantity_2__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Quantity_3__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Quantity_4__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Quantity_5__c)) ), TRUE, FALSE)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: If this quote contains multi Quantity Breaks, this box will be checked.
CustomField.label: Has Multi-Qty Break
